directions.name: Rust line
directions.idea: The studio's name becomes the ground: a deep rust field across which one unbroken off-white fine line keeps redrawing itself, like a needle that never repeats a motif.

palette.role: stencil-lilac accent for drafts and button

directions.type: Big Shoulders Display Black for huge, tall, condensed headlines that feel cut and stamped. Instrument Sans Regular for running text and lists, set in sentence case.
directions.composition: Hero: the wordmark Rja sits top left and the nav top right; the headline spans columns 1–9 at about 11vw in three stacked lines, the intro sits in columns 9–12 lower right, and a single fine line drawing of a fern runs from behind the headline off the right edge. Next comes a deep-oxide band with the four services as a left-aligned list, each name large with the line weaving between them. The last section is split: the phone as a giant numeral with one lilac rectangular button on the left, and the hours table and address on the right.
directions.imagery: Single-weight off-white line drawings of botanicals, a swallow and a hand-drawn letterform, drawn as one continuous stroke. A few short dashed segments are tinted lilac like stencil transfer.
directions.signature: One continuous hairline travels down the whole page, turning into a fern, then a swallow, then underlining the phone number. It never breaks and never repeats.
directions.imagePrompt: One flat full-page website screenshot, 1536×1024, no browser or device frame. Page ground deep rust #8A3216. Top left wordmark "Rja" in tall condensed black grotesque, off-white #F3ECE6; top right nav, small sans: "Domov", "Delo", "Posvet", "Kontakt". Hero, left-aligned on 12-column grid: headline "Vsak motiv narisan na novo" in huge tall condensed heavy sans, off-white, three stacked lines spanning columns 1–9. Lower right, columns 9–12, intro in clean sans: "Majhen tatu studio v Mariboru. Tetovaže po vaši zgodbi, nič iz kataloga. Samo z naročili." One continuous single-weight off-white hairline drawing of a fern passes behind the headline and bleeds off the right edge, with a few dashed segments in stencil lilac #B9A8F0. Below, a full-width band in deep oxide #4A1A0C: left-aligned list of four large condensed service names, "Tetovaže po meri", "Fine-line in drobni motivi", "Prekrivanje in popravki", "Posvet in osnutek", with the same hairline weaving between them into a small swallow. Bottom section back on rust: left, the phone "040 555 318" as a giant condensed numeral underlined by the hairline, with one rectangular lilac button with square corners and off-black text "Pokličite"; right, a simple hours table "Tor–pet 12.00–20.00", "Sob 10.00–15.00" and address "Koroška cesta 41, 2000 Maribor". No gradients, no shadows, no photos, no people.

directions.name: Osnutek
directions.idea: The page works like the consultation itself: every drawing appears twice, first as a loose grey construction sketch and then as the final clean rust line laid over it, slightly offset.
directions.type: Bodoni Moda in upright high contrast for headings, sharp like a fine needle line. Hanken Grotesk for body text and the hours table.
directions.composition: Hero: the wordmark sits top left and the nav runs along a thin rule; a large botanical drawing fills columns 7–12 and bleeds off the top and right edges. The headline sits in columns 1–7 at about 8vw, with the intro below it on the left. Next, a pale lilac field covering columns 1–8 acts as tracing paper over the services, which are listed as a two-column list with hairline dividers. The last section shows a draft-and-final swallow on the left and, on the right, the phone numeral, the button, the hours and the address.
directions.imagery: Pen-drawn line art in two layers: graphite construction strokes (circles, guide lines, loose hatching) with a precise rust fine line drawn over them. There is no fill and no texture.
directions.signature: The draft-and-final double drawing, with grey sketch lines visibly sitting under the clean rust tattoo line.
directions.imagePrompt: One flat full-page website screenshot, 1536×1024, no browser or device frame. Pure white ground #FFFFFF, off-black text #1A1714. Top left wordmark "Rja" in an upright high-contrast Didone serif; nav in small grotesque on a thin hairline rule: "Domov", "Delo", "Posvet", "Kontakt". On the left, columns 1–7, the headline "Vsak motiv narisan na novo" in a large upright Didone serif, no italics. Below it, intro in grotesque: "Majhen tatu studio v Mariboru. Tetovaže po vaši zgodbi, nič iz kataloga. Samo z naročili." Next section: a pale lilac rectangle #E4DDFB covering columns 1–8 like tracing paper, holding a two-column list with thin dividers: "Tetovaže po meri", "Fine-line in drobni motivi", "Prekrivanje in popravki", "Posvet in osnutek". Bottom section: on the left a small swallow drawn as a grey draft with a rust final line; on the right the phone "040 555 318" as a large serif numeral, one rectangular rust button with square corners and off-white text "Pokličite", a simple hours table "Tor–pet 12.00–20.00", "Sob 10.00–15.00" and the address "Koroška cesta 41, 2000 Maribor". No gradients, no shadows, no photos, no people.
